summary: Stack-based SPFA can exceed its vertex-visit threshold and incorrectly report a negative cycle in an acyclic graph. The fix uses a FIFO VecDeque instead. The added tests/spfa.rs test spfa_no_neg_cycle checks this behavior. Blocked: a compiling verbatim reversal requires changes in both src/algo/spfa.rs and src/algo/johnson.rs, but the schema permits only one reversal path. Restoring SPFA's Vec parameter leaves Johnson's unconditional caller passing VecDeque; restoring only pop() leaves an unsupported VecDeque method. No valid single-file verbatim region was established.
